P_calibration.quote: Courts often treat government licenses as not being compensable property, so this is better framed as a workability or fairness point than a strong legal claim.

P_holdback.quote: Counsel should weigh which points to surface publicly and which to hold for post-enactment analysis.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Deliberately structuring around a criminal statute can itself support a finding of willfulness under Sec. 5(b).
